exposure: surgical approaches (laparoscopic, robotic, hysteroscopic, vaginal, laparotomy)
disposable materials and equipment used in surgery
outcome: excess use of surgical supplies (opened but unused)
cohort: The study observed 99 minimally invasive benign gynecologic surgeries performed by surgical teams at a university-affiliated single tertiary medical center.
finding: Excess use of disposable materials and equipment is common in minimally invasive benign gynecologic surgeries, contributing to superfluous costs and excess environmental waste, with robotic surgery having the highest contribution to total cost.
cross-section timing: Data was collected during July to September 2022.
